blocks.text: Is hisse mein hum UML diagrams ki chaar qismein parhenge jo neeche di gayi hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Chaar diagrams aur un ka kaam (kitab aage har ek ko alag topic mein samjhati hai):

blocks.caption: Is chapter ke chaar UML diagrams
rows: actors (users) aur woh kaam (use cases) jo woh system se karwate hain
classes, un ke attributes aur methods, aur aapas ke rishte
objects ke darmiyan messages, waqt ki tarteeb mein
kisi process mein steps aur faislon (decisions) ka bahao

blocks.prompt: Objects ke darmiyan messages ki tarteeb dikhane ke liye kaun sa UML diagram banayenge?
blocks.explanation: Sequence diagram: is mein objects saath saath hote hain aur un ke darmiyan messages upar se neeche waqt ki tarteeb mein dikhaye jate hain.

items: Chaar UML diagrams: use case, class, sequence, activity.
